intake.question: What is it, in one sentence?
intake.hint: What it is supposed to do, precisely. Detect and kill mosquitoes how, in what space.

intake.question: Role, timeline, status
intake.hint: Solo? When are you starting? What is the realistic finish date.

intake.question: What made it hard?
intake.hint: Detection at that size, tracking something that moves erratically, flight time, or doing anything lethal safely indoors. Which one worries you most.

intake.question: What did you decide, and what did you reject?
intake.hint: CV on board versus off board. Which platform. What the actuator is. Name what you have already ruled out.

intake.question: What number can you put on it?
intake.hint: Target detection range, frame rate, flight time, weight budget, parts budget.

intake.question: What broke, and what did you do?
intake.hint: Nothing yet. Keep this box open and fill it in the day something fails, because you will not remember it later.

intake.question: What media do you have?
intake.hint: Photograph the build as you go, especially the parts that fail. That folder is what makes this case study writable.

intake.question: What would you do differently?
intake.hint: Two sentences. Not self criticism, a design judgement you would make differently now.
